_comment: "Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link." combat.no_defense_reactions is READ in four places (play.py's reaction-step offer and _defense_reaction_legal_check; actions.py for hand and arsenal) and was SET BY NOTHING. All three cards with this text wrote a dead SET_FLAG instead -- under TWO different names -- so they looked implemented and blocked nothing. Same shape as DamageEvent.unpreventable: the reader existed, the writer did not. The "if this was played from your banished zone" gate was CARD_IN_ZONE zone:BANISHED, which asks whether a card is SITTING in the banished zone -- true whenever anything is banished, and unrelated to where THIS card was played from. PLAYED_FROM_ZONE is the real condition. Blood Debt is printed and fires from the card DB.
